facts.text: Živí se mrtvými rostlinami a houbami, loví i jiné plže.
facts.quote: It is a detrivore, cleaning up dead plants and fungi, and a carnivore known to pursue other slugs

facts.text: Často ho napadá bílý parazitický roztoč.
facts.quote: this species is often infested by the white parasitic slug mite Riccardoella limacum
The lifespan of Limax maximus is 2.5–3 years.

facts.text: Po nočním hledání potravy se vrací do své štěrbiny.
facts.quote: after its nocturnal rambles or foraging expeditions, usually returns to the particular crevice or chink in which it has established itself
The adult body length is 10-20 cm (4-8 in).

facts.text: Přes den se ukrývá pod kameny nebo pod padlými stromy.
facts.quote: hiding during the day beneath stones, under fallen trees, or other obscure and damp places
